title: PyCardano: The Ultimate Course for Python and AI Developers

ms.promise:
1. Create a detailed course plan
2. Introduction to PyCardano video series:
・Course Overview – 3–5 min
・Environment Setup (Windows) – 5–7 min
・Environment Setup (Ubuntu) – 5–7 min
・Environment Setup (MacOS) – 5–7 min
・Project Initialization & First Test – 8–10 min
・Basic Concepts in Blockchain (Part 1) – 10–12 min (cover: blockchain fundamentals, decentralization, nodes, consensus)
・Basic Concepts in Blockchain (Part 2) – 10–12 min (cover: transactions, blocks, addresses, wallets, UTxO model)
・Advanced Concepts in Blockchain – 12–15 min (cover: smart contracts, Cardano architecture, native tokens, dApp integration)
ms.criteria:
- The detailed course plan is completed and publicly shared.
- 8 videos are produced and publicly available on YouTube and LMS by the Vietnamese with English subtitles.
Quality criteria:
・Resolution: minimum 1080p, clear audio.
・Format: YouTube standard.
・Each video must achieve 50+ views and 5+ engagements (likes/comments) within 30 days after publishing.
